browser: Playwright Chromium on loopback production build

checks.title: vanilla component releases subscriptions and aborts in-flight requests across repeated mounts
MapLibre host disposes real map instances while remounting the same component
unmounting during a real active job clears poll timer and stops browser requests
Cancel in the browser reaches terminal cancelled state with no completed result
map host executes actual backend, object view and reproducible export
vanilla host executes actual backend, object view and reproducible export
fire requires explicit polygon and assumption before a real run
Qwen API unavailable is distinct from computed results and never falls back
invalid time window is rejected before committing an action
map selection opens baseline object and routing vehicle is independent of blocked class

scope.G501: Five vanilla remounts verify map-selection listener count returns 1/0, old request signals abort, held in-flight request aborts; three real MapLibre adapter disposal/reinstantiation cycles verify old canvas removal, no duplicate subscriptions, one active canvas; a held real worker run verifies unmount aborts requests, clears poll timer and stops further status fetches.
scope.G503: A browser click posts Cancel to the real RunService while its worker is active at a test-only synchronization gate. The gate is released; UI and persisted API state become cancelled, result endpoint returns 409, no result table/export, run-complete event or result fetch is observed.

limitations: The worker hold is test-only and precedes normal analysis; this checks the cancellation contract and real API/job lifecycle, not cancellation latency during a long production SUMO subprocess.
MapLibre disposal is checked by canvas removal, idempotent dispose and listener counts; no browser heap snapshot, GPU-driver accounting or worker-process memory profiling.
